# has organization name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOrganizationName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

Relates an organization to a structured [`gmeow:OrganizationName`](../classes/gmeow-OrganizationName.md) it bears; the organization-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md), mirroring [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md) for persons and [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](gmeow-hasPlaceName.md) for places. Non-functional — an organization bears many co-equal names (legal, trading, former, multilingual); none is primary, and superseded ones set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:OrganizationName`](../classes/gmeow-OrganizationName.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md) from [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) to [`gmeow:OrganizationName`](../classes/gmeow-OrganizationName.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
